candidates.title: Bill Gates' daughters join mother to sign as founding backers of $100 million fund
candidates.excerpt: Melinda French Gates, alongside her daughters, has joined a groundbreaking philanthropic venture designed to enhance women's health globally. The Women's Health Co-Lab aims to generate $100 million, supporting diverse organizations over three years. Phoebe Gates highlights the ongoing challenges women encounter in health and safety. With over $70 million already pledged by prominent philanthropists, the initiative is actively seeking more funding to meet its goal and broaden its reach.
